text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Very dark plum fitted V-neck cardigan with antique brass front and cuff buttons over raspberry pink camisole, black fitted jeans, brown slouchy knee-high boots.. Add ONLY these accessories: A fine silver necklace with a round engraved silver locket pendant, entire chain visible in a closed oval.; A women’s medium black leather shoulder bag with a long slim strap and small metal fittings.; A long dark olive green lightweight scarf with subtle fringed ends, shown in a loose drape, entire object visible.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Very dark plum fitted V-neck cardigan with antique brass front and cuff buttons over raspberry pink camisole, black fitted jeans, brown slouchy knee-high boots.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A fine silver necklace with a round engraved silver locket pendant, entire chain visible in a closed oval.; A women’s medium black leather shoulder bag with a long slim strap and small metal fittings.; A long dark olive green lightweight scarf with subtle fringed ends, shown in a loose drape, entire object visible.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
